stories.title: Inside the stunning 72-hour Lakers sale -- and the uncertainty that still looms
stories.summary: Three days of secret talks resulted in Mark Walter flipping the Lakers -- and reignited yet another round of bickering among the six Buss siblings.

stories.title: Raptors without Kawhi for weeks due to knee swelling, sources say
stories.summary: Kawhi Leonard is expected to miss a period of weeks due to swelling in his left knee, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: Sources: Miss. State QB Taylor facing surgery, to miss rest of season
stories.summary: Mississippi State QB Kamario Taylor, college football season's breakout star this season, is facing season-ending surgery on his injured toe, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: One win away: Brewers ride 8-run fifth to Game 3 rout, 3-0 World Series lead
stories.summary: The Brewers blew open Game 3 with an eight-run fifth inning and rolled to a 10-1 win over the Rays to move within one win of their first World Series title.

stories.title: Stokes hears MVP chants as stellar Game 5 puts Valkyries on brink of WNBA title
stories.summary: Kiah Stokes had 13 points, eight rebounds and three blocked shots -- accompanied by MVP chants -- as Golden State moved within one win of a championship in its second season.
